authority: Non-authoritative P1 validator vocabulary; descriptive only

rules.implementation: /9 is a strict /8 superset; malformed P1.13 fields are caller configuration errors
gateways, flows and targets are declared referents; unresolved refs use P1_BINDING_CONTEXT_REQUIRED
at most one default, distinct conditional order, no order or condition on default
each flow has at most one incoming owner and one outgoing owner
other gateway types remain UNRESOLVED; their flows still count as declared
routing binds to the token gateway's outgoing targets; on_flow binds to declared flows; other predicates unchanged
P1 checks single statements only; trace conformance and recorded conditions belong to LIB
